purpose: Content-bound equivalence between production apply-time migration versions and the exact canonical repository migration artifacts that produced them. Entries are recognized only while the pinned Git blob SHA matches the local file. A repository_version_state of history_placeholder is an explicit, read-only-verified exception for a canonical version row recorded in production migration history with null name/statements; unclassified direct repository-version presence remains a hard mismatch.
